metadata.title: Surrealist Oceanic Horizon with Celestial Reach

retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist composition featuring a wet hand reaching from the right toward a floating Earth over a vast ocean, framed by horizontal color bars.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with top and bottom color bars
excludeWhen: the request is for a realistic space documentary style
the request requires a vertical portrait orientation
the request is for minimalist flat vector art

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle seascape where a wet, glistening human arm enters from the right frame, reaching toward a small, detailed globe of Earth suspended in a cloudy sky. The composition is anchored by two thin, horizontal orange-yellow bars at the extreme top and bottom edges containing wide-tracked sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand's diagonal reach creates a tension line toward the floating Earth in the upper left quadrant.
The horizon line bisects the image, separating the textured blue water from the soft, white-clouded sky.
The horizontal color bars act as a formal frame, containing the surreal imagery within a structured graphic layout.
The scale of the hand is disproportionately large compared to the Earth, emphasizing a sense of cosmic surrealism.
coreInvariants: The presence of a floating Earth in the upper left sky.
A human hand entering from the right edge reaching toward the center-left.
Thin horizontal color-filled bars at the top and bottom margins.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hand is a large foreground element on the right; the Earth is a medium-scale focal point in the upper left; the ocean provides a vast background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glistening hand serves as the primary visual anchor due to its high contrast and detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the arm from the right edge, moves along the fingers toward the Earth, then drops to the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the open sky and the expansive surface of the ocean.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cerulean and cyan blues of the ocean and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange-yellow used for the framing bars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and the white/green/blue of the Earth globe.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky and low value in the deep water; the framing bars are highly saturated to pop against the naturalistic scene.

letterConstructionRules: Strictly geometric circular and rectangular forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide letter spacing (tracking) to span the full width of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking and placement for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and clean monolinear strokes.
Provides the necessary geometric purity for the wide-tracked layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a calm blue ocean under a cloudy sky. In the upper left, place a small, realistic Earth globe. From the right edge, a wet, glistening human arm and hand reach toward the center. Ensure the horizon is level.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin orange-yellow horizontal bars at the very top and bottom edges. Inside these bars, typeset uppercase geometric sans-serif text with extreme letter spacing so it spans the entire width.

verificationChecks: Is the Earth globe in the upper left quadrant?
Is the hand reaching from the right side?
Are the top and bottom bars present with wide-tracked text?
Is the ocean horizon clearly visible?

adjustableVariables: Specific phase or rotation of the Earth globe
Intensity of the wetness/glisten on the hand
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or band names in the text
Ensure the hand does not look distorted or AI-generated with extra digits
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered within the color bars.
Verify the hand's anatomy is correct and the skin texture is detailed.
Ensure the Earth globe has a soft shadow or glow consistent with the sky lighting.
Confirm the color bars are of equal height at top and bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Seascape] + [Floating Earth] + [Reaching Hand] + [Geometric Framing Bars with Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif].
